name: day_19_cold_start_small_segments
source: synthetic (gen by hand): a cold start of 6,000 30MB segments on 8 idle 16-core nodes, QueryNode load concurrency 32 (cpu x middlePriority coefficient), production dispatch tick 500ms. Measures initial_load_seconds: the pacer must not throttle a burst of small loads below what the nodes can take (tick-bound dispatch did: 26s against 3s without the pacer, before loads were dispatched on slot release and the cap grew by slow start).
